evidence.note: Clean editorial title: large serif headline, sans subtitle, italic byline, soft blue background blobs; generous whitespace.
Triangle loop diagram with consistent card nodes, colour-coded blue/red arrows and check badges; definition tile sits under the diagram it explains; nothing collides.
Numbered timeline left, server panel with agent fan and package mirror centre, quote tile right; consistent eyebrow/serif-quote treatment, uncluttered.
Two quote tiles stacked at right (KAM1196A, EARLY[BIG]) crowd the lower right edge and sit far from the diagram elements they narrate.

Automated scorer card and its document stack overlap the lower agent fan lines; 'never read transcripts' label runs past the right edge of the OpenAI servers panel into the faint public-internet column.
Typography consistent across deck (serif titles, blue tracked eyebrows, grey sans body, serif italic quotes); the faint 'Public internet' column is near-invisible on every diagram step.
Three evenly sized insight cards with serif headings, bulleted body, italic quote and underlined sources; consistent and well spaced over the blurred diagram.
Closing slide mirrors the title treatment; consistent.

rationale: Styling, components and typography are consistent and considered across every slide, with purposeful step-built diagrams and opaque pop-overs that read cleanly. The densest slide (s-5 late steps) falls below the rest: the scorer card overlaps the agent fan, its label spills out of the panel, and stacked quote tiles crowd the corner. That matches level 4: considered throughout with one slide below the rest.
